issues.title: Keyspace USE failure discards connection unconditionally, no permanent/transient split
issues.verdictReason: The new Err(ConnectionSetupError::Keyspace(err)) arm at connection_pool.rs:900-911 always discards the connection, sets had_error_since_last_refill, and calls update_shared_conns (which emits ConnectivityChangeEvent::Lost via emit_events, confirmed at line ~1165) once the pool is empty, with no distinction between a transient failure and a permanently bad/dropped keyspace; the old code (pre-PR, kept the connection and logged warn!) never had this failure mode, so a persistently bad current_keyspace can now drain a pool to Broken instead of just logging.
issues.scopeReason: The discard-on-keyspace-failure behavior is new code added by this PR's Err(Keyspace) arm.

reportedAs.review-and-fix-pr: A bad or dropped keyspace causes every pool to drain and go Broken

reportedAsByRun.rafp-native-claude-retest-2026-10-09/qui: Three places (session.rs:2008, cluster/worker.rs:351, connection_pool.rs:1287) store the new keyspace before USE succeeds and never roll it back, so after a failed use_keyspace or a DROP KEYSPACE every new/replacement connection fails USE and is discarded, pools shrink and go Broken(UseKeyspaceError), sending a Lost event, and pools for nodes added later never become ready; permanent errors are not distinguished from transient ones and the previous behavior of keeping the connection with a warn! is gone.

issues.title: Keyspace-change race: Err(Keyspace) arm never retries with the now-current keyspace
issues.verdictReason: The Ok(...) arm (lines 915-929) compares evt.keyspace_name against self.current_keyspace and re-issues start_setting_keyspace_for_connection if they differ, but the new Err(ConnectionSetupError::Keyspace(err)) arm (900-911) does no such comparison and just discards the connection; pre-PR, every USE attempt (success or failure) flowed through the Ok(...) path and thus got this mismatch check/retry, so a keyspace change racing with an in-flight USE used to trigger a retry with the new keyspace, which no longer happens.
issues.scopeReason: The missing retry-on-keyspace-change check is a direct consequence of adding the new Err(Keyspace) branch in this PR.

reportedAs.review-and-fix-pr: Stale-keyspace USE failure drops a connection instead of retrying with the new keyspace

reportedAsByRun.rafp-native-claude-retest-2026-10-09/qui: The error arm never compares evt.keyspace_name with current_keyspace and the connection is already dropped inside the USE future, so if the keyspace changes while an old USE is in flight and fails, the connection is lost and backoff grows, whereas the base code would have re-issued USE with the new keyspace.

(line 903-906), even though the consequence (connection discarded, possible pool drain) is now worse than silently keeping a wrong-keyspace connection.
